Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 FeCe dual-atom catalyst co-anchored on hollow carbon fibers breaks the activity-stability trade-off in zinc-air batteries. Ce sites scavenge ROS and decompose H₂O₂ while modulating Fe centers, boosting ORR activity and preventing carbon degradation. It delivers 2300 cycles (~1100 h) of stable operation, offering a new pathway for ultra-durable zinc-air batteries.

item.title: Reprogramming Interfacial Hydrogen-Bond Networks via Asymmetric Single-Atom Catalysts
item.description:
کاتالیزور تک‌اتمی نامتقارن Co-N3O1 با بازبرنامه‌ریزی شبکه پیوند هیدروژنی بین‌سطحی، احیای اکسیژن و عملکرد باتری روی-هوا را بهبود می‌بخشد.
ACS Catalysis | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Asymmetric Co-N3O1 single-atom sites, formed via rapid Joule heating, break local symmetry to reprogram interfacial hydrogen-bond networks, weakening over-connected water networks and boosting proton transfer. This yields superior four-electron oxygen reduction (0.866 V half-wave) and high-performance zinc-air batteries, establishing asymmetric single-atom modulation as a new paradigm for catalyst-water interface engineering.
🏷 single-atom catalyst · hydrogen-bond network · oxygen reduction · zinc-air battery · Co-N3O1
